ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 1:5 ratio of high-intensity (white/mottled) pixels to low-intensity (dark/black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white mottling is concentrated in the upper-medial regions of both lobes, transitioning to solid low-intensity black towards the center and lower margins near the water line.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central depression with an approximate obtuse angle of 115 degrees and low vertical depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude peaks ranging from 5-15 pixels, particularly pronounced on the outer thirds of both trailing edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the superior trailing edges leading to sharp, upward-turned distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular pixel groups (barnacles) are densely localized on the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization present on the distal tips of both lobes; no major structural amputations or deep traumatic scarring detected in visible regions.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced 'ragged' topography on the trailing edge near the tips, creating a highly irregular silhouette against the background.
